title: Hearty Crusty Slovakian Bread Gratin
description: A rich and savory Slovakian bread gratin featuring stale bread, mustard, and a blend of cheeses. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over low heat.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together eggs, flour, salt, and black pepper.
In a greased 6-cup ramekin, arrange a layer of stale bread cubes.
Spread a layer of Dijon mustard over the bread cubes.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of shredded Gruy9re cheese and 1/4 cup of grated Parmesan cheese.
Repeat the layering process two more times, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Dust the top layer of cheese with a pinch of flour.
Beat the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until smooth and brush evenly over the top layer of cheese.
Cover the ramekin with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the parchment paper and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the top layer is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5-7 minutes before serving.
Slice and serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
